name: Complete coverage checklist; unqualified transitions are explicit NOT_RUN

steps.title: Hardware identity and PGOOD
steps.procedure: Read factory FPGA DNA and MCU EEPROM serial under leases. Match enrolled UID, integrated build and stable physical PGOOD.
steps.limits: MCU EEPROM serial and FPGA IDCODE are not unique factory identity. CPU factory signature not read.

steps.title: JTAG chain and168 static CPLD–FPGA links
steps.procedure: Validate13 IDCODEs. Program checksum-verified link diagnostic into FPGA SRAM only.338 walking-one/zero vectors in each of gateware and independent boundary-scan receive paths. Restore checksum-verified integrated image, initialize private link, verify build and repeat HDMI/ADC/TDC functional tests.
steps.limits: Static connectivity, not at-speed margin or analog quality. Expected SYS reset from deliberate FPGA SRAM reconfiguration; never reset or program MCU/CPLD/flash.

steps.title: GTX internal PRBS, MAC loopback and external link
steps.procedure: Exercise GTX PRBS and MAC loopback with negative controls; restore integrated image. External PM↔Kasli private link checked separately by integrated suite.
steps.limits: Legacy1000BASE-X image expects old exact40MHz clock. Requalify with present40.0787MHz; old PASS is historical only.
steps.blocked: Legacy1000BASE-X image expects old exact40MHz clock. Requalify with present40.0787MHz; old PASS is historical only.

steps.title: I2C mux address inventory and bus topology
steps.procedure: Single-branch scans through both muxes, address readback and decoded monitor IDs; preserve current/voltage samples.
steps.limits: Legacy runner programs older FPGA and restores obsolete baseline. MCU telemetry is integrated, exhaustive topology adapter still requires migration.
steps.blocked: Legacy runner programs older FPGA and restores obsolete baseline. MCU telemetry is integrated, exhaustive topology adapter still requires migration.

steps.title: FPGA configuration flash ownership and read-only access
steps.procedure: Verify ownership guard, PROGRAM_B hold, JEDEC and bounded READ03, bus release, reload integrated SRAM image.
steps.limits: Destructive to volatile FPGA state. Qualified current-image restoration/recovery adapter required; stored-image boot remains unconfirmed.
steps.blocked: Destructive to volatile FPGA state. Qualified current-image restoration/recovery adapter required; stored-image boot remains unconfirmed.

steps.title: Power sequencing and timeout shutdown
steps.procedure: Observe EN-to-PG rise and timeout shutdown without replacing original MCU protection; record rails and fault state.
steps.limits: Fault injection and power-cycle qualification NOT_RUN; static PGOOD is not equivalent.
steps.blocked: Fault injection and power-cycle qualification NOT_RUN; static PGOOD is not equivalent.

steps.title: CPU peripherals, SPI walking patterns and power telemetry
steps.procedure: Read PING, GPIO, temperature ID, three TDC chip IDs, PLL, FPGA signature, 32 walking patterns with scratch restoration, INA and POWER. Recheck PGOOD before sensor access.
steps.limits: No power cycling or timeout fault injection. Unfitted P3V8 shunt: voltage only; no current acceptance. Sensor numeric limits require a frozen acceptance specification.

steps.title: HDMI, all digital ADC paths and stimulated TDC
steps.procedure: Four HDMI lanes: walking discovery and slow/fast PRBS, empty frames; SPI signature reads only. Capture both ADC banks, synthetic and physical, all12 channels. Quiet/stimulated/quiet TDC:64 pulses to configured channel. Check uptime.
steps.limits: TDC stimulus only on the physically connected channel. No calibrated ADC analog acceptance for unconnected channels. HDMI SPI writes disabled: bus shared with MCU.

steps.title: Gate delay versus internal DAC-A
steps.procedure: Establish explicit DAC-A0000 baseline;20 code points0..65535; common trigger and ISERDES phase buffers; restore0000 and verify phase return. Save every raw capture.
steps.limits: Sampled centroid, nominal sample metadata; no calibrated absolute phase/jitter claim. Original20MHz CPLD gate divider required.

steps.title: ADC differential transfer and adjacent data-bit coverage
steps.procedure: SCPI DAC differential−1.2..+1.2V, commonmode1V,257 points, ADC A/B. Decode4096-word buffers at STR edges, verify tags/generations;12 bits and11 neighbor pairs, all4 states with sufficient population. Restore1V/1V.
steps.limits: Requested voltage, no calibrated gain/DNL. Per-pin0..3.3V ceiling. Functional persistent-tie test, not resistance/pin-order/timing-margin proof.

steps.title: CFD analog monitor DC levels
steps.procedure: Read all8 monitor nodes with DMM7510, correct divider ratios, leave all shared monitor muxes inhibited.
steps.limits: Original script is channel12-specific. Parameterized multi-module inhibition and DMM/wiring qualification required.
steps.blocked: Original script is channel12-specific. Parameterized multi-module inhibition and DMM/wiring qualification required.

steps.title: Internal DAC B/C/D transfer curves
steps.procedure: 65 code settings perDAC, three DMM readings per setting, corrected analog-node voltage and verified explicit-code restoration.
steps.limits: Original script is channel12-specific. Per-channel restore codes, shared mux inhibition and DMM wiring must be configured.
steps.blocked: Original script is channel12-specific. Per-channel restore codes, shared mux inhibition and DMM wiring must be configured.
